column2: Last time the big friend came right off. This time it will not come off, because there are no little beads to take it off with. So we take the big friend off with a small friend. Add ten first, then take the big friend using five. Two friends, one answer.
Two rods now: tens and units. Always start on the left, with the tens. Then do the units. If the units make a whole ten, that ten jumps left to the tens rod. That is a carry.
Four rods now: thousands, hundreds, tens, units. Keep your eyes moving left to right and do not lose your place. Same friends, same carries, just a longer walk.
Your turn now. Add ten first, then let the small friend finish the big friend.
Bixi is so close! The big friend will not come off by itself. Which small friend helps it off? Show Bixi.
Good catch, Bixi. Start on the left, the tens, so the carry has somewhere to land. Which rod first?
Not quite — have another try.
Bixi found a tricky one! When a carry lands on a rod that is already full, that rod makes a whole ten too. Which way does that ten go next?
Bixi's tens rod is overflowing. When the tens make a whole ten, a big friend carries one rod to the left. Which rod is that?
Solve it, then tell me the answer.
Work it out — you've got this.
Move the beads, then tap Check.
Bixi needs a small friend! When there aren't enough little beads, slide the five-bead down, then take its small friend off. Which small friend?
Your turn. Not enough little beads? Slide the five-bead down, then take its small friend off.
Bixi needs a big friend! When there's no room, add ten on the next rod, then take the big friend off here. Which big friend?
Your turn. No room on the rod? Add ten next door, then take the big friend off.
Bixi needs a big friend! When there aren't enough to take away, take ten from the next rod, then add the big friend back. Which big friend?
Your turn. Not enough to take away? Take ten from next door, then add the big friend back.
Oh Bixi, times is not adding! Times means groups: count the number up, one group at a time, and add as you go. Can you show Bixi the real answer?
Your turn. Remember, times means groups — count the number up, one group at a time.
Your turn. Not enough little beads to take away? Take the five-bead off, then add its small friend back.
Your turn. No room on the rod? Add ten next door, then take the big friend off.
Your turn. Not enough to take away? Take ten from next door, then add the big friend back.
Your turn. Start on the left — tens rod first, then units. If the units make a ten, carry it left.
Your turn. Picture the first number, then add the next one in your head. What do you see?
Your turn. Tens rod first, then units, every time — and when a rod fills, carry left.
Your turn. Left to right — hundreds, then tens, then units, one rod at a time.
Your turn. Push up the beads for the first number, then add the next. Move them and tap Check.
Your turn. Set the number, then take the next one away. Move the beads and tap Check.
